reason: Proposal A directly tackles the soft-ferromagnetism limitation by substituting a magnetically active element (Mn) in a way that is both physically plausible for high-entropy FeCoNi alloys and straightforward to test against the Pd/Pt baseline. Its mechanism of partial antiferromagnetic coupling and lattice distortion is well-grounded and presents a clear, non-trivial route to increased coercivity under the stated constraints.
